title: Injectivity of bounded core coding
statement: Let $B$ be a natural number and let $c,d$ be configurations of the same $k$-tape machine on the same bit-string input, with state type $S$. Suppose that for each work tape, each head position in $c$ and $d$ has absolute value at most $B$, and every cell containing a symbol on either configuration has position of absolute value at most $B$. If the bounded core codes of $c$ and $d$ agree, then their cores agree.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a natural number of work tapes
$c,d$ are configurations over bits on input $x$
Every work-tape head position of $c$ and $d$ has absolute value at most $B$
Every nonblank work-tape cell of $c$ and $d$ lies at a position of absolute value at most $B$
The bounded core codes of $c$ and $d$ agree
